verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's results docs describe both a Bayesian and a Frequentist engine, with outputs such as 'Chance to Win', statistical analysis and health checks. The GitHub README lists variance reduction (CUPED, post-stratification) alongside sequential testing, bandits and SRM checks, and a GrowthBook team member's community comment confirms the Bayesian engine design. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how the CUPED/post-stratification variance reduction works (evidenced only by a README bullet), and independent or hands-on validation of the engine's correctness.
